title: Stick-figure and martial-arts animation sources
purpose: A verified shortlist of free/open 2D animation sources for stick figures and martial-arts combat, compiled for reuse in HTML5 games and for deciding what may be redistributed.
method: Scraped OpenGameArt advanced search (12 keyword queries over 2D art), itch.io search (6 queries), Wikimedia Commons categories (Stick figures, Martial arts animations) and GitHub repository search. For every entry the item page was opened and its licence block, author, file list and animation list were read on 2026-11-18. A licence is only recorded here when the item page itself states it.

licencePolicy.allowedInThisRepo: CC0-1.0 only. Everything under freebuff-assets/ must be redistributable without attribution or share-alike obligations.
licencePolicy.conditional: CC-BY and CC-BY-SA allow redistribution but add attribution and/or share-alike duties. Use them directly in a game, and import them here only after the library's licence policy is widened (with an attribution file).
licencePolicy.excluded: Paid store items, 'free download, licence not stated' packs, and store mirrors whose licence forbids redistribution of raw files.

rejectedSources.reason: 63 results, but each animation carries its own uploader licence and many are free-tier-only; no blanket open licence is stated, so none can be mirrored.

rejectedSources.source: GitHub repository search (stickman animation / stick figure fighting)
rejectedSources.reason: Results are games and animation tools (e.g. StykAnimate, stickman-kino, Stickman-Arena) whose code may be licensed but whose sprite art has no separate licence. No redistributable animation pack found this way.
3D humanoid rigs, not stick figures, and the terms prohibit redistributing the animations as assets.
Free-with-account assets whose licences forbid redistributing the raw files and often cap commercial use; not compatible with an open asset library.

recommendation.notes: Only the CC0 entries (RGS stick figure, stick man runner, dancing stickman, spritesheet of a man, Mustermann karate, kung-fu battlers, Streets of Fight, Kung Fu Man Gameboy) can be imported into freebuff-assets/ without changing its CC0-only policy. CC-BY and CC-BY-SA packs are usable in a game with credit, but not eligible for mirroring here.
